description: This file provides range and tuple support for the {fmt} formatting library, including range detection, formatting, and utilities for various container-like types, tuples, and ranges.

classes.name: is_map
classes.description: Type trait to check if a type is a map (has a mapped_type).

classes.name: is_set
classes.description: Type trait to check if a type is a set (has a key_type and is not a map).

classes.name: has_member_fn_begin_end_t
classes.description: Trait to detect if a type has member begin() and end() functions.

classes.name: is_range_
classes.description: Trait to determine if a type is a range based on begin() and end() presence.

classes.name: is_tuple_like_
classes.description: Trait to check if a type is tuple-like (supports std::tuple_size).

classes.name: is_tuple_formattable_
classes.description: Trait to check if a tuple-like type is formattable with a given formatter.

classes.name: range_reference_type_impl
classes.description: Helper to determine the reference type of a range.

classes.name: range_formatter
classes.description: Formatter for range types, supporting various container-like types.

classes.name: formatter
classes.description: Template specialization for formatting range-like and tuple-like types.

classes.name: join_view
classes.description: View for joining range elements with a separator.

classes.name: tuple_join_view
classes.description: View for joining tuple elements with a separator.

classes.name: is_container_adaptor_like
classes.description: Trait to detect container adaptors like std::stack, std::queue.

classes.name: all
classes.description: Wrapper to access the underlying container of a container adaptor.

methods.name: range_begin
methods.description: Returns the beginning iterator of a range or array.

methods.name: range_end
methods.description: Returns the ending iterator of a range or array.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses format specifiers for range and tuple formatters.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats range or tuple objects into output context.
